description: This file defines an enumeration for date options used in report mailing jobs, providing methods to create instances from strings and IDs, validate options, and convert to a representative data format.

classes.name: ReportMailingJobStretchyReportParamDateOption
classes.description: Enum representing various date options (Invalid, Today, Yesterday, Tomorrow) for report mailing jobs, with utility methods for instantiation, validation, and conversion.

methods.name: newInstance(String value)
methods.description: Creates an enum instance based on the provided string, matching against Today, Yesterday, Tomorrow, or defaults to Invalid.

methods.name: newInstance(Integer id)
methods.description: Creates an enum instance based on the provided integer ID, matching the predefined options.

methods.name: getCode()
methods.description: Returns the code string associated with the enum value.

methods.name: getValue()
methods.description: Returns the display value of the enum option.

methods.name: getId()
methods.description: Returns the integer ID associated with the enum value.

methods.name: isInvalid()
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is the INVALID option.

methods.name: isValid()
methods.description: Checks if the enum instance is a valid option (not INVALID).

methods.name: validValues()
methods.description: Returns an array of valid option values (excluding INVALID).

methods.name: toEnumOptionData()
methods.description: Converts the enum instance to an EnumOptionData object for UI or data transfer.

methods.name: validOptions()
methods.description: Returns a list of EnumOptionData objects for all valid options.
